name: Bhandara Basadi
description: One of the largest Basadis in town, dedicated to the 24 Tirthankaras. It is known for its intricate carvings and peaceful meditation hall.

name: Chandragiri Hill
description: A sacred hill holding deep historical significance, featuring several ancient Jain basadis, intricate inscriptions, and the tomb of Chandragupta Maurya.

name: Shri Eshwara Swamy Temple
description: A beautiful ancient Shiva temple reflecting traditional architecture, offering a serene atmosphere for devotees amidst the Jain heritage sites.

name: Charugiri Hill
description: A historical stone pavilion erected as a memorial honoring the Jain monks who attained Sallekhana (peaceful fasting unto death).

name: Shri Jain Matha
description: The central religious institution of Shravanabelagola, home to the local pontiff and featuring stunning traditional brass idols and ancient wall paintings.

name: Sri Anjaneya Temple
description: A highly revered local Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Hanuman, attracting residents and devotees for daily prayers and special weekend blessings.

name: Sri Rama Temple
description: A peaceful shrine dedicated to Lord Rama, offering a tranquil space for chanting and meditation away from the main pilgrimage bustle.

name: Vindhyagiri Hill
description: The iconic, larger hill requiring a climb of around 600 rock-cut steps. It houses the majestic 57-foot monolithic statue of Lord Gomateshwara.
